meta.title: Plinth | AI-Accelerated Engineering
meta.description: We build scalable software in exactly half the time. Driven by AI acceleration, architected by deep system engineering experience.

work.label: Enterprise System
work.description: A fully automated resource planning system processing 50k+ transactions daily with sub-second latency.
prose: The client was crippled by a legacy system requiring manual intervention for basic inventory routing. We architected a new centralized ERP from scratch in 6 weeks using AI generation for boilerplate CRUD.
The core innovation was a custom inference pipeline that automatically predicts stockouts and reroutes supply chain logistics before human operators are even aware of the deficit.

work.label: Data Pipeline
work.description: High-throughput edge ingestion network capturing IoT data across 5,000 global nodes.
prose: Replacing a fragile polling architecture, we designed a robust, event-driven streaming platform capable of handling intense data velocity without dropping packets.
By leveraging AI to rapidly scaffold the microservice layer, we focused our manual engineering effort purely on optimizing the message queue buffers and database partition strategy.

services.label: Full-Stack Web
services.heading: Scalable Platforms
services.body: We don't just build React frontends; we engineer the entire vertical stack. From complex state management to highly-available multi-tenant databases, we build platforms designed to handle massive scale from day zero.

services.label: Mobile Engineering
services.heading: Native-Grade Apps
services.body: Cross-platform mobile applications that actually perform. We build sophisticated, offline-first mobile architectures that leverage device hardware effectively, avoiding the sluggishness of typical web-wrapped apps.

services.label: Data & Automation
services.heading: Intelligent Pipelines
services.body: We integrate LLMs and robust ETL pipelines to eliminate your operational drag. If your team is doing manual data entry or manipulation, we will build a system to automate it entirely, freeing human capital for actual problem solving.
